evidence: The refractive index, measured using variable angle spectroscopic ellipsometry, is found to be ∼2.8 within the ALD window. Film growth within the ALD window at 250 °C [Fig. 3(b)] is uniform (4.7% nonuniformity) and smooth (0.6 nm RMS roughness) across a 5 in. Si wafer. From GIXRD, it is found that as-deposited films are cubic Co3O4.
